summary: The diff implements Promise.withResolvers in its own file, following the spec steps in order. Step 1 binds `this` to ctor. Step 2 calls NewPromiseCapability(ctor) and propagates its error with `?`. Step 3 creates the object from %Object.prototype%. No test-shaped branches, no hardcoded values, no swallowed errors, and no changes outside the one file. The only cosmetic change is renaming unused parameters to `_args` and `_new_target`.
